Saving String into the Redis ,
How Redis does that step by step:
1. Redis first looks at the Command "SET" which means store.
2. Redis interpretes the the "message" as a key and "Hi Sayantan here" as a value, and store it as a key value pair.
3.  After saving redis sends a response to us as OK as it has fullfilled the command.

SET message "Hi Sayantan here"

How "GET" works inside Redis  step by step:
1. Redis first looks at the Command "GET" which means retrive.
2. Redis interpretes the the "message" as a key and finds whatever value is stored in that perticular key.
After saving redis sends a response to us as OK as it has fullfilled the command.
3. Remember For one key we can store only one value , if we give  multiple values for the same key "message", then only the latest one will remain and other will be deleted ans redis during updating , deletes the old value and apply the latest value only for that perticular key.
